meta.solver: LSODA reference (model.run, rtol 1e-7) for S4/S7/S10a; analytic quasi-steady metrics for S12 (E_u/Pbar) and S13 (Dynkin mean, F6)

notes: elasticity step: central +-5 % (PROTO formula); voltages +-10 mV reported as % TTE per +10 mV; T_lim +-1 K reported as % TTE per +1 K
S12/S13 metrics are smooth L0 quantities with quasi-steady (F5) powers: resistance and cut-off parameters have no effect on them by construction
RAT factor: every state with a data path is forced to Wi-Fi (lo), LTE (mid) or 5G NSA (hi); navigation (NV) and tracking (TRK) stay cellular
